# Source Code Portal (SCP)

> Dashboard and documentation portal for the repositories of a GitHub organisation: one static Go binary with an embedded React SPA, an immutable in-memory read model refreshed by a sync engine, SQLite as a last-good cache, an OpenAPI-first `/api/v1`. This file guides agents working on the repository itself; the portal's own `/llms.txt` is a product feature.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture in one screen, enforced rules, commands, conventions.
- [docs/design/README.md](docs/design/README.md): map of the binding design documents (decisions, architecture, ADRs, one design per unit).
- [docs/design/10-architecture.md](docs/design/10-architecture.md): package map (section 4), dependency matrix (section 5.2), Go signatures (section 8).
- [internal/archtest/rules.go](internal/archtest/rules.go): the executable form of the dependency matrix (closed world).

## Working rules

- [docs/design/04-decisions.md](docs/design/04-decisions.md): binding decisions; section 7 amendments win over section 4.
- [docs/design/11-adr/](docs/design/11-adr/): decision records ADR-001..025; new ones in [docs/adr/](docs/adr/).
- [docs/design/02-design-guardrails.md](docs/design/02-design-guardrails.md): the design guardrails (GR-01..GR-45) every change must respect.
- [docs/design/20-design/93-deviations-and-open-questions.md](docs/design/20-design/93-deviations-and-open-questions.md): settled and open questions.

## Contract and generated files

- [api/](api/): OpenAPI 3.1 roots (spec first); bundles in [internal/apispec/](internal/apispec/); generated code is committed and drift-checked (`make gen-check`).
